findings.reason: the count is the section's motivating measurement; corrected, §6 reads 82 pairs with 43 silent and §7's "other half" (39) reconciles with it, whereas the node reading "40" would hunt for a smaller set than the fragment defines.
findings.text: §6 states "In about half of 40 confused domain pairs the guidance is silent", but the run it cites (scg-domain-path-measure) records 39 separating pairs and 43 silent pairs — 82 confused pairs in all, 43 of them silent (≈half). The total "40" matches neither the pair count (82) nor the silent count (43), and §7 then calls the complement "the other half" of the same set, so both sections' arithmetic rests on a total the evidence does not contain.
